mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' default Cybernetic Oscillator crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a normalized band-limited swing direction change; follow the new sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict nonpositive-to-positive Cybernetic Oscillator crossing; short on a strict nonnegative-to-negative crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: The Cybernetic Oscillator applies a 30-period recursive high-pass then a 20-period SuperSmoother and normalizes the band-limited result by its 100-decision RMS. It is not a moving-average crossover, raw high-pass, unnormalized return sum, range oscillator, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the normalized swing transition must coincide with completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse normalized recursive bandpass sign transitions are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.cybernetic_oscillator: 30-period high-pass of close, 20-period SuperSmoother, divided by 100-period RMS
features.event: strict finite oscillator zero crossing from the immediately prior finite oscillator
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: all recursive and RMS state resets after any invalid completed four-hour bar; output requires 100 uninterrupted smoothed high-pass values

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers Cybernetic Oscillator(30,20,100) zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, recursion, initialization, RMS, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Making A Better Oscillator, TASC June 2025
external_basis.fixed_definition: HPLength=30, LPLength=20, RMSLength=100; published recursive high-pass and SuperSmoother; CyberneticOsc=smoothed high-pass/RMS; zero line
external_basis.selection_use: published defaults, formula, normalization, and zero line only; no incidence or outcomes
